name: Elena Rybakina
intro: Elena Rybakina plays for Kazakhstan. She is the number 2 seed, a ranking badge for top players. Fans call her the Ice Queen because she stays so calm.
story: As a little girl, Elena did gymnastics and ice skating. Then she grew too tall, so she tried tennis instead! In 2022 she won Wimbledon, and in 2026 the Australian Open. Those are Grand Slams, the four biggest tournaments. She was the first player from Kazakhstan ever to win one.

funFacts.text: Her serve can zoom at 127 miles per hour. That is faster than a car on the highway.
She hit 516 aces in 2025. An ace is a serve nobody even touches!
She has a beagle named Mulia. She has visited animal shelters to help pets find homes.
She once met a kangaroo in Australia and posted the photo.
She went to a regular school and practiced tennis only two hours a day.
She is shy and quiet, but she loves posting pictures of desserts.

watchFor: Watch the speed sign after her serve. It can hit 127 miles per hour!
